producer.name: Bruichladdich
producer.about: Bruichladdich is a distillery in the village of Bruichladdich on Islay. The Harvey brothers built it in 1881, with Robert to build it, John to run it and William to handle the business. It was closed in the 1990s, bought in 2000 by private investors led by Mark Reynier, and restarted distilling on 29 May 2001.

spec.label: Flavouring or botanicals
